rows.note: Use 信 as the all-purpose noun for letters or written messages sent to someone.

example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 sau1 dou2 nei5 fung1 seon3

rows.note: Use this for the similar aspects or points of resemblance between different things.

example.english: There are many points of correspondence between these two paintings.
example.traditional: 呢兩幅畫有好多相似嘅地方。
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 fuk1 waa2 jau5 hou2 do1 soeng1 ci5 ge3 dei6 fong1

rows.note: Use this for an ongoing exchange of letters between people rather than for the individual letters themselves.

example.english: They have maintained correspondence by letter for many years.
example.traditional: 佢哋多年嚟都有書信往來。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 do1 nin4 lei4 dou1 jau5 syu1 seon3 wong5 loi4
